description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity 'FragmentListArray' which demonstrates the use of a ListFragment to display a list of items from a predefined array, specifically using the 'Shakespeare.TITLES' data. It contains an inner static class 'ArrayListFragment' extending ListFragment to manage the list display and handle item clicks.

classes.name: FragmentListArray
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating a ListFragment usage within an Android activity.

classes.name: ArrayListFragment
classes.description: Inner static class extending ListFragment that sets up the list using Shakespeare.TITLES and handles item clicks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, adds the ArrayListFragment if not already present.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Called when the fragment's activity created, sets up the list adapter with Shakespeare.TITLES.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by logging the clicked item's ID.
